::: {.profile-heading}
<h1>Sheng’en Li</h1>
:::

::: {.profile-bio}
I am an undergraduate student in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science in the dual-degree program at [Duke Kunshan University](https://www.dukekunshan.edu.cn/) and [Duke University](https://duke.edu/).

I study how to evaluate and improve learning and decision systems under feedback, temporal dependence, and modeling uncertainty. My work spans counterfactual evaluation, sequential detection, and numerical verification.

Oh, and these are my [notes](blog/index.qmd){.intro-link .intro-notes} and [tools](tools.qmd){.intro-link .intro-tools}. You might want to have a look.
:::
::::
